headline: Kano Free Trade Zone Generates N40bn in Customs Revenue
summary: Nigeria's Kano Free Trade Zone reached N40 billion in customs revenue, hosting 87 operational enterprises that contribute to job creation and foreign investment.
why: Free trade zones serve as economic hubs for manufacturing and trade in developing economies, driving regional industrial output and government non-oil revenues.

impacts.name: Nigeria
impacts.why: Increased customs revenue reflects growing manufacturing and trade activity.
